CalibrationSubtitle: Choose a display and prepare a calibration preset.
DisplayHint: Color mode is a read-only probe (sdr, wcg, hdr, advanced-color, or unknown). Unknown is not SDR. Nothing here changes the display.
FoundationMessage: You can save and share preset drafts. These controls do not change your display yet; the calibration engine is in development.
TonalHint: Look for smooth transitions from black to white. This reference is shown through your current display settings.
PresetsSubtitle: Keep your adjustments together, or import a preset shared by someone else.
PresetSafety: Importing only adds a preset to your library. A shared preset still needs to be checked on your own display.
ReferenceMessage: Original photography will be added here as visual references for each calibration step.
ReferenceCategories: Neutral grays · Natural skin tones · Deep shadows · Bright highlights · Saturated colors
LanguageHint: App text updates immediately. Some system dialogs may need an app restart.
StartupHint: Automatic preset restoration will be enabled after the calibration engine and recovery checks are ready. This build only records startup status.
StartupState_unpackaged: Startup is available in the installed MSIX version.
StartupState_DisabledByUser: Disabled in Windows. Enable DCCW++ in Settings > Apps > Startup.
StartupState_DisabledByPolicy: Startup is disabled by your organization.
StartupState_EnabledByPolicy: Startup is enabled by your organization.
AgentHint: Use dccwpp --help --json to discover commands. The installed app provides the dccwpp.exe execution alias.
DraftLoaded: Preset loaded into the editor. Your display has not changed.
